steps.title: Factor lab gains an Evidence column
steps.narration: The Research factor lab now shows an 'Evidence (D10 · 20d)' column next to every factor. At a glance you can see which factors have certified out-of-sample backing and which are still awaiting their verdict.
steps.point_out: The 'Evidence (D10 · 20d)' column header in the factors table — two rows show a green 'Proven' chip and the rest show a muted 'Not yet proven'.

steps.title: vcp_contraction 'Proven' badge links to its evidence
steps.narration: Clicking the accent-colored 'Proven' badge on the vcp_contraction row jumps directly to that factor's certified ledger entry — no searching needed on the Evidence page.
steps.point_out: The Evidence page scrolls straight to the vcp_contraction claim row, showing the holdout edge of +3.33%, p-value 0.01149, the 'vs SPY' control, and the registration date.

steps.title: Round-trip back to the factor lab
steps.narration: Every evidence row knows which research surface it backs. Clicking 'Backs: Research factor lab →' returns you to the factor lab in one step, closing the loop between the two pages.
steps.point_out: You're back on the Research factor lab — the vcp_contraction 'Proven' badge is intact, confirming the round-trip works in both directions.

steps.title: Evidence ledger — all four certified claims
steps.narration: The Evidence page is the master ledger. The newest entry, vcp_contraction, joins the three existing claims — each row shows its verdict, supporting numbers, and the research surface it backs.
steps.point_out: Four claim rows on the page. The vcp_contraction row at the bottom shows 'Proven' with +3.33% edge. The ma_stack row shows its FAIL verdict honestly. Each row links back to its origin surface.

steps.title: Stocks leaderboard — Leadership Proven, no vcp_contraction
steps.narration: On the Stocks leaderboard, each score column carries the badge that matches its evidence. The vcp_contraction edge backs the factor lab only — it does not appear here, keeping each surface honest about what it actually measures.
steps.point_out: The LEADERSHIP column shows 'Proven' on every stock row. ENTRY QUALITY and RISK show 'Not yet proven'. The text 'vcp_contraction' is absent from this page entirely.

steps.title: Stock detail page with Leadership score
steps.narration: Clicking into any stock opens its detail page where the Leadership score certification travels with the stock. The 'Proven' badge sits right alongside the score.
steps.point_out: The Leadership score section on this stock's detail page with its 'Proven' badge visible and ready to expand.

steps.title: Proof drill-down panel opens on demand
steps.narration: Clicking 'Why proven?' unfolds the full certification — the out-of-sample holdout result, the SPY control comparison, the p-value, and the exact date the claim was registered.
steps.point_out: The expanded proof panel showing 'vs SPY', the holdout edge percentage, p-value, and registration date all pinned in the ledger.

steps.title: Factor lab — honest badges across every factor
steps.narration: Back at the factor lab, every factor now has an honest badge. The two that have cleared the out-of-sample bar show accent 'Proven' chips; the rest say 'Not yet proven' until the data makes the case.
steps.point_out: Side-by-side contrast: vcp_contraction and Leadership score showing 'Proven' in accent color; ma_stack and all other factors showing 'Not yet proven' in muted grey — discoverable without any extra steps.
